UC-502.en: Claude doesn't ask before these in this matter: you chose “Always for this matter”.
UC-502.hi: इस मामले में Claude इनसे पहले नहीं पूछता: आपने “इस मामले के लिए हमेशा” चुना था।

UC-503.en: Run: {command} / Edit: {file} / Read: {file} / Any page on {site} / Use tool: {server} {tool}
UC-503.hi: चलाना: {command} / बदलना: {file} / पढ़ना: {file} / {site} का कोई भी पेज / टूल का इस्तेमाल: {server} {tool}
UC-503.note: one row per kept rule, by kind: a Bash command; a file Claude may change (relative to the matter folder when inside it); a file it may read (whole path when outside); WebFetch, which covers every page on the host; an MCP server and its tool

UC-504.note: each row's button; its accessible name, the row's own words; the list's one way out
